hreflangReasoning: Use the language-only code 'id' (ISO 639-1 Indonesian) on <html lang> and in hreflang. Indonesia is the only market, and no regional variant (id-ID) would carry different copy, prices or law. Never use the deprecated code 'in' (legacy Java/Android) or invalid forms like pinterestdownloader.io's 'id-05'. Malaysian Malay is a different language ('ms'). A few Malaysian phrasings show up even with gl=id ('cara nak save video dari pinterest'), but they don't justify an ms page. Each id page lists itself ('id'), its English twin ('en') and x-default (English). Skipped pages get no id alternate.

markets.pinterestHost: id.pinterest.com (Pinterest Indonesia; shared links also arrive as pin.it). Already accepted by PINTEREST_URL_RE in src/lib/extract/constants.ts, as is www.pinterest.co.id through pinterest\.[a-z.]+
markets.notes: Mobile-first, Android-majority market. Searchers mix English tool words ('downloader', 'download', 'save', 'link', 'board') with Indonesian grammar ('cara … di hp', '… ke galeri', '… tanpa aplikasi').

urlStructure.pattern: /id/<indonesian-slug>; the homepage is /id (no trailing slash, per normalizeCanonical in src/lib/urls.ts)
urlStructure.slugRule: Lowercase ASCII, hyphens, in the same word order as the winning query ('download-video-pinterest', not 'pinterest-video-download'). Indonesian needs no transliteration.
keptEnglishWords: download (the dominant search verb; 'unduh' slugs would miss the head terms)
urlStructure.breadcrumb: BaseLayout hard-codes the breadcrumb root as name 'Home' at '/'. For id pages it should be 'Beranda' at /id.

voice.address: Use 'kamu' (lowercase), consistently; never mix it with 'Anda'. Prefer the imperative with no pronoun ('Tempel link…', 'Simpan ke galeri'), as the existing i18n strings do, so the pronoun is rarely needed. Why 'kamu': the audience is young and mobile (autocomplete is full of 'pp aesthetic', 'gimana cara…', 'cara nge save…'), Indonesian consumer brands such as Telkomsel's how-tos use 'kamu', and every competitor's stiff 'Anda' is part of why they read as machine-translated. Fallback: if the team wants Pinterest's own register, use 'Anda' everywhere. Either works, as long as it's consistent.
voice.case: Title tags and headings follow PUEBI title case: capitalize every word except short function words (di, ke, dari, dan, yang, untuk, tanpa, atau) unless they come first or right after a dash. Example: 'Cara Menyimpan Video Pinterest ke Galeri HP tanpa Aplikasi'. The display H1 is uppercase anyway.
voice.free: gratis (never 'cuma-cuma'). 'free' appears only inside English completions.
voice.noLogin: tanpa login (top completion); 'tanpa akun', 'tanpa daftar' for variety.
voice.noApp: tanpa aplikasi (top completion: 'download video pinterest tanpa aplikasi', 'ke galeri tanpa aplikasi'); 'tanpa install aplikasi' on device pages.
voice.noWatermark: tanpa watermark (dominant; 'tanpa tanda air' and 'tanpa wm' exist but are rare). In descriptions write 'tanpa watermark tambahan' (we add none; creator watermarks stay).
voice.quality: HD, Full HD 1080p, 'ukuran asli' (original size), 'resolusi asli'. 'pecah' = pixelated/blurry, the word users use ('agar tidak pecah'). Never '4K' as a promise.
voice.phone: HP (everyday word for a phone: 'di hp', 'ke galeri hp'). 'ponsel' only in formal body text, at most once. Laptop, PC, komputer, MacBook as is.

verbs.download: download: titles, H1s and slugs. Inflect the Indonesian way: 'didownload' (passive, attached), 'mendownload' (sparingly). In body copy and buttons use 'unduh' / 'mengunduh' / 'diunduh' (standard Indonesian, matches Pinterest's 'Unduh gambar' and the existing i18n button 'Unduh MP4').
verbs.save: simpan / menyimpan = save a file to the device. Always name the destination ('simpan ke galeri', 'simpan ke laptop'), because Pinterest's own 'Simpan' button means 'save to a board'.
verbs.saveColloquial: 'save' (as in 'cara save video pinterest') appears in queries. Use it only as a keyword, never in UI.
verbs.paste: tempel (UI); 'paste' only in a parenthetical once
verbs.copy: salin ('Salin tautan', as in the app); 'copy link' in body copy once for searchers ('cara copy link pinterest')
verbs.extract: ambil / proses (not 'ekstrak', and not 'mengekstrak' as in the current i18n processingText 'Mengekstrak media HD…'; suggest 'Mengambil file HD…')
verbs.convert: ubah / jadikan ('Ubah video Pinterest jadi MP4'); 'convert' is what people search ('convert pinterest to mp4'); 'konversi' has no demand
verbs.tap: ketuk (mobile), klik (desktop), as Pinterest help does

claimTicket.ticket: tiket for the UI. 'karcis' is the old-fashioned word for a printed claim ticket (karcis parkir, karcis penitipan) and fits the printed world in a single display line, but keep labels to 'tiket'.
claimTicket.admitOne: 'Admit one · public link' → 'TIKET · TAUTAN PUBLIK' (short, fits the label strip) or 'BERLAKU 1 TAUTAN · PUBLIK'. Avoid the literal 'UNTUK 1 ORANG' (admission to an event, wrong meaning).
claimTicket.serial: 'No.' is native Indonesian shorthand for 'nomor'; keep 'No. 1120…' untranslated (translate="no" is already set).
claimTicket.stub: The stub has no visible label of its own; its text is the action ('Unduh MP4', 'Ambil ZIP'). If a perforation hint is ever printed: 'SOBEK DI SINI'. Internal name: 'sobekan tiket'.
claimTicket.collect: ambil ('Ambil file', 'Ambil di loket'). 'Nothing public to collect' → 'Tidak ada konten publik untuk diambil'. 'Couldn’t collect this link' → 'Link ini tidak bisa diambil'.
claimTicket.counter: loket (ticket counter), only if the metaphor surfaces in copy
claimTicket.receipt: struk (everyday word for a shop or ATM receipt). 'tanda terima' is too formal.
claimTicket.voidStamp: BATAL (the standard word stamped on cancelled tickets and documents; 5 letters, fits the stamp). 'TIDAK BERLAKU' is too long.
claimTicket.okStamp: Type stamps translate the link type: 'Board → ZIP' → 'Papan › ZIP', 'Profile → Avatar' → 'Profil › Foto', 'Profile → ZIP' → 'Profil › ZIP', 'Pin · short link' → 'Pin · link pendek'. 'Not Pinterest' → 'Bukan Pinterest'. Use › because the display font has no → glyph.
claimTicket.tagline: 'Link is the ticket, the file is what you collect' → 'Link-nya tiketnya, filenya yang kamu ambil.' Or as a hero lede: 'Tempel link, ambil filenya.'

formats.thousands: period from 4 digits in prose (1.200 Pin, 12.500); none in technical values (1080p, 600 × 600 px, 2026)
formats.units: space between number and unit: 4,2 MB, 1200 px, 30 detik; none in 720p/1080p. Formats in caps: MP4, JPG, PNG, GIF, ZIP, MP3
formats.dateLong: 15 Oktober 2026 (Intl.DateTimeFormat('id-ID', {dateStyle: 'long'})); months: Januari Februari Maret April Mei Juni Juli Agustus September Oktober November Desember
formats.time: 24-hour clock with a period: 14.30 (Intl id-ID output); avoid naming time zones (Indonesia has three: WIB/WITA/WIT)
formats.currency: Only if ever needed: Rp0 / Rp15.000. Prefer the word 'gratis'.
formats.quotes: “…” and ‘…’ (same as English); quote UI labels in bold or “…”: “Salin tautan”, “Unduh gambar”
formats.dash: Title separator: the em dash with spaces ' — ', not the en dash. BaseLayout.astro builds the breadcrumb name with title.split('—')[0], so an en dash would put the whole title into the breadcrumb.
formats.lists: 'A, B, dan C' (no Oxford-comma rule; the comma before 'dan' is optional, so be consistent)

typography.glyphCoverage: Checked with fontkitten against public/fonts/big-shoulders-display-latin-{800,900}-normal.woff2: every A–Z, a–z and 0–9 glyph is present (Indonesian needs no diacritics), and so are — – “ ” ‘ ’ · × … › » ‹ «. Missing: → (U+2192). The current stamps ('Board → ZIP', 'Profile → Avatar') already fall back to Arial Narrow for that arrow in English. For id stamps use '›' ('Papan › ZIP') or add → to the subset.
typography.lengthExpansion: Indonesian body copy runs about 15–30% longer than English (affixes, function words), but the H1s stay compact because they follow the query ('Download Video Pinterest' is as long as 'Pinterest Video Downloader'). Widths below are measured from glyph advances at 900 weight and 46px (phone): DOWNLOADER 234px, MENYIMPAN 213px, DOWNLOAD 193px, PINTEREST 177px. All fit the 343px phone column. Tool H1s set in 2 lines; 'Pinterest ke MP4' in 1; the guides and the Chrome page in 3 (see pages[].h1Fit). Keep the 3-line pages' ledes to one sentence so the ticket stays in the first viewport.
typography.widows: The 3-line H1s end on a short word ('… KE / GALERI', '… DI / LAPTOP', '… DI / HP', '… DI / CHROME'). Bind the preposition to the next word with a non-breaking space (di HP, ke Galeri, di Laptop, di Chrome) so 'DI'/'KE' never end a line and 'HP' never sits alone.
typography.breaking: Indonesian has no long compounds, so H1s need no soft hyphens. Use hyphens:manual in body text: browser hyphenation dictionaries for Indonesian are patchy. Keep 'pin.it', 'MP4' and '1080p' unbroken (nowrap on inline format chips).
typography.uppercase: text-transform:uppercase is safe: Indonesian has no special case mapping (unlike Turkish i/İ). Still set lang="id" on <html> for screen readers.
typography.labels: Gothic label (14px, 0.08em tracking, weight 900): 'TIKET · TAUTAN PUBLIK' measures 138px against 153px for 'ADMIT ONE · PUBLIC LINK', so it fits. The 'BATAL' stamp is 103px against 79px for 'VOID' at 46px, about 30% wider, so check it in the stamp box at its real size.
typography.buttons: Stub button 'Unduh MP4' (9 characters, 204px at 46px/900) is as long as the English one. Avoid 'Download Sekarang' (17 characters) in the stub.

notes: 15 of 19 pages are worth localizing; 4 are skipped (profile ZIP, carousel, 4K, SEO title generator). Priority 1 = home, video, photo, the 'cara download' guide and the gallery guide: they carry the head terms ('pinterest downloader', 'download video pinterest', 'download foto pinterest', 'cara download video pinterest', 'cara menyimpan video pinterest ke galeri').

Cannibalization plan for the four video guides (the English set overlaps too): 'cara download video pinterest' = the general hub, covering every device plus 'tanpa aplikasi' and 'tanpa watermark'; 'ke galeri' = the save-verb and troubleshooting page ('tidak masuk galeri'); 'di hp' = Android + iPhone step paths; 'di laptop' = Windows/Mac/PC. Each links to the other three with its own anchor text. The tool page /id/download-video-pinterest owns the bare 'download video pinterest'.

Honesty: 'tanpa watermark' means we add none. 4K is never promised (the English 4K page conflicts with PRODUCT.md and should be fixed upstream). The profile picture page says 'ukuran penuh / terbesar yang tersedia', not 'HD', because avatars are about 600 px. Private pins and boards: always 'tidak bisa'. Telegram bots and apps: don't mention or disparage any by name. Footer line: 'PintDownload tidak berafiliasi dengan Pinterest Inc.'

Pinterest's 'Simpan' means 'save to a board', not 'save to the phone'. Several queries ('cara menyimpan video di aplikasi pinterest') come from people confused by exactly this. Every guide should say so once, quoting Pinterest's own sentence: 'Menyimpan Pin berarti menambahkan Pin ke salah satu papan Anda.'

Spelling traps: 'di' is a separate word before places ('di HP', 'di laptop') but attached as the passive prefix ('didownload', 'diunduh', 'disimpan'). Avoid the common errors 'di download' and 'didalam'. 'Pin-nya' and 'link-nya' take a hyphen after a non-Indonesian or capitalized word.

Existing src/lib/i18n.ts id strings need a pass: heroTitlePrefix/heroSubtitle promise 'Full HD 1080p' unconditionally (change to 'hingga 1080p jika tersedia'); 'Mengekstrak media HD…' → 'Mengambil file HD…'; 'Unduh Papan' can stay (the UI follows the app's word 'papan'; only titles, slugs and keywords say 'board'); 'Alat Chrome' → 'Bookmarklet Chrome'.
Dates and years: keep years out of id titles. The English guide title '(2026 Free Guide)' needs a yearly edit; the id titles don't.

The 'download video pinterest di google' completions come from Android users who browse Pinterest in the Google app or Chrome. The Chrome page and the HP guide should both mention opening the Pin in a browser and copying the address bar.
Data-quota FAQ ('kuota'): a real local concern raised by a competitor. Answer it with the real file size the receipt already shows (no invented averages).

Risks: (1) the story page depends on the id version having real tool + FAQ content (the English source page is thin), and 'story pinterest' intent is partly Instagram-template seekers; (2) the how-to SERP is dominated by big publishers (detik, tirto, CNN Indonesia), so the guides need device-accurate screenshots; (3) the Indonesian iOS and Android labels (Simpan Video, File › Unduhan, Galeri) must be checked on a device; (4) autocomplete gives presence and rank, not volume.
